interest: Consuls reported Japanese tuberculosis remedies, from Dr. Seigo Funaoka's serum to kerosene therapy.
overview: Two cross-reference sheets (1932–34) on Japanese tuberculosis treatments: Dr. Seigo Funaoka's serum, reported from Kobe, and a kerosene 'cure' reported from Singapore.

people.name: Seigo Funaoka
people.role: Professor and medical researcher at Kyoto Imperial University

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a despatch from Kobe transmitting publications on a new tuberculosis serum developed by Dr. Seigo Funaoka.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Dickover's April 30, 1932 Kobe despatch on Dr. Seigo Funaoka's tuberculosis serum.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch from Kobe on Tuberculosis Serum

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a despatch from Singapore enclosing a newspaper article on an experimental kerosene treatment for tuberculosis being tested in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Singapore Despatch No. 104 (January 1934) on a kerosene tuberculosis 'cure' tried in Japan.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch No. 104 from Singapore on Kerosene Treatment for Tuberculosis
